records.text: Johnny's Locker was an Everyday Heroes Like You program intended to support children and teens facing life-altering and emotional hardships in hospitals, shelters, or protective facilities.

appearances.snippet: Johnny's Locker is an everyday Heroes Like You program that is targeted towards enhancing the lives of children and teens undergoing life-altering and various emotional hardships that reside in hospitals, shelters, or protective facilities across the country.
